## History

Twenty years prior, Sarah liked Luther Wallace, but her father sent him away because he was poor. Every spring, she was forced to whitewash an old duckhouse on her property that her father kept in case it became useful. When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) got trapped in the duckhouse roof while trying to look in Sarah's pantry window, Sarah returned home after a rainstorm and freed her. After hearing Anne's explanation and sharing tea with her, Sarah agreed to sell [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a blue willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P56](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0056), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P57](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0057), +4 more_
